description: Run with AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true in the environment (see docs/README.md). A live AWS Glue Data Catalog. Credentials come from the AWS credential chain (AWS_PROFILE, environment, ...); set AWS_CONFIG_FILE / AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE explicitly because the test runner overrides HOME.
on_init: CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, PROVIDER credential_chain, REGION 'eu-central-1');
